_comment: EXT-63 SMOKE, arm 6 — arm 4 with the SINGLE change frequency_mode dual -> triple.
PURPOSE: remove a confound I introduced.  Every arm with a CORRECT ionosphere level
(the W6 self-contained lineage, a00 30-46 TECU against COD's own GIM at 32.24) is TRIPLE;
every EXT-CB arm, all of which start at a00 ~13 TECU, is DUAL.  Dual was chosen for good
reasons (COD .BIA has zero GPS C5/L5 entries; their clock is IF(C1W,C2W)) but it is now
entangled with external-vs-internal biases and has to be separated.
WHAT HAPPENS TO L5 HERE.  estimation.require_bia_for_signals is inherited ON, and it
gates CODE signals with no .BIA entry — so GPS C5 is DROPPED while L5 PHASE is kept and
its satellite bias is carried by the estimated satellite phase-bias state plus the float
ambiguity.  That is the only coherent triple posture available without new code: with
require_bia_for_signals OFF the L5 code would enter UNCORRECTED at full weight
(no_bia_code_downweight is 1.0 on this lineage) with no state to absorb it, injecting a
satellite bias straight into the iono field — strictly worse and strictly more confounded.
⚠️ PREDICTION, stated BEFORE the run so the result cannot be rationalized afterwards:
this arm may well be a NULL for the level.  The absolute ionosphere level is set by the
GEOMETRY-FREE CODE, and with C5 dropped the GF code content here is L1/L2 — IDENTICAL to
the dual arm.  L5 phase adds geometry-free information but carries an ambiguity, so it
constrains iono TIME-VARIATION, not the absolute level.
So read it as an ELIMINATION, not a fix:
a00 still ~13 TECU  => the -19 TECU offset is INDEPENDENT of frequency mode.  The dual
choice is exonerated, and the next lever is the mapping-function
spread (estimation.ionosphere_weighting.elevation_cutoff_deg 25 ->
10), which is what physically separates level from DCB.
a00 moves toward 32  => frequency mode WAS load-bearing for the level, which would be a
surprise worth chasing on its own terms.
The genuinely complete triple posture is different and needs a card: estimate the
satellite OSB for BAND 5 ONLY (external .BIA for bands 1/2).  Odijk 2016: from f=3 onward
each extra band's code bias is unabsorbed and estimable, REFERRED TO THE (1,2) IF BASIS —
which is exactly the basis COD's .BIA and .CLK already put us in, so it lands in the right
frame by construction.  Not reachable today: W6 is all-signals-or-nothing and is
hard-errored against external_sat_code_bias, and the W6 code-bias datum builds an IF pin
across two frequencies which a band-5-only OSB must NOT have (it is already IF-referenced;
it needs the per-(const,signal) sum-to-zero alone).
Everything else is identical to arm 4, so the pair is a clean single-knob A/B.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY: frequency_mode is fingerprinted.
